list.name: org_id
list.label: Org
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT org_id::text FROM campaign_cost_attribution ORDER BY 1

list.name: campaign_id
list.label: Campaign (for agent breakdown)
list.query: SELECT campaign_id::text FROM campaign_cost_attribution GROUP BY campaign_id ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(u.email,'system/unattributed') AS user_email, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS campaigns, COUNT(*) AS llm_calls, SUM(a.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(a.output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(a.input_tokens + a.output_tokens) AS total_tokens, SUM(a.total_cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM campaign_cost_attribution a JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = a.campaign_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.created_by WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR a.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

SELECT COALESCE(u.email,'system/unattributed') AS user_email, SUM(a.total_cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM campaign_cost_attribution a JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = a.campaign_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.created_by WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR a.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

SELECT COALESCE(u.email,'system/unattributed') AS user_email, SUM(a.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(a.output_tokens) AS output_tokens FROM campaign_cost_attribution a JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = a.campaign_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.created_by WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR a.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY (SUM(a.input_tokens)+SUM(a.output_tokens)) DESC

SELECT a.campaign_id::text AS campaign_id, COALESCE(u.email,'system') AS created_by, c.status, COUNT(*) AS llm_calls, SUM(a.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(a.output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(a.total_cost_usd) AS cost_usd, MIN(a.created_at) AS started FROM campaign_cost_attribution a JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = a.campaign_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.created_by WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR a.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY a.campaign_id, u.email, c.status ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT agent_name, model_alias, model_resolved, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(total_cost_usd) AS cost_usd, ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)) AS avg_latency_ms FROM campaign_cost_attribution WHERE campaign_id::text = '$campaign_id' GROUP BY agent_name, model_alias, model_resolved ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
